main_text.p: re. Deferere: Abstrahere, Avertere se, Retrocedere: item ulcisci ex usu Chaldaico. Niphal נִפְרַע Abstrahi, Avertere se, Hiphil הִפְרִיעַ Abstrahe.
פֶּרַע m. Coma. פְּרָעָה f. Ultio: plur. פְּרָעוֹת.

פָּרַץ Rupit, Erupit, Difr. Ir. Per. Rupturam fecit, Effregit: Urfit, Infuit, & tunc cum ב construitur. Interdum copia est, Erumpere in multitudinem, Multiplicari, Augescere, Crescere. Niphal נִפְרַץ Erumpi, Perrūpi. Pyhal פֻּרַץ Dissumpi. Hithpahel הִתְפָּרֵץ Abrumpere se, Desistere.
פֶּרֶץ m. Ruptura, Eruptio, Irruptio: plurale, פְּרָצוֹת & פְּרָצִים.
פָּרִיץ m. Effractor, Iruptor, Violentus: Latro: plur. פְּרִיצִים Latrones, Jer.7.11.
פָּרַק Rumpere, Abr. Disr. Dilacerare: Eripere. Chald. פָּרַק Abrumpe. Pihel פָּרֵק Perrumpere, Perfringere, Abrumpere. Hith. הִתְפָּרֵק Rumpi, Abrumpi, Frangi: Abrumpere, Detrahere.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and some Latin abbreviations are reproduced approximately from a faded scan; the page is partly stained at the right and lower edges. Marked readings are doubtful.
